text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: About a year before the founding of the guild "Alces Atelier"... A girl was plodding along.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これは【アルケス錬金堂】結成のおよそ一年前──
一人の少女がとぼとぼと歩いていた。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Grandpa, you dummy. You big idiot... I hate my grandpa... just kidding, I love him. ...But I hate him. But I love him...I don't know
text_block_list.orig_text:
おじいちゃんのバカ。
あほ。
おじいちゃんなんて大嫌い……
うそ、
大好き。
……だけど大嫌い。
でも大好き……
分かんない。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Damn it... *sniffle*
text_block_list.orig_text:
うう……
くそぉ……
……ぐすん。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Iroooha. ...Oh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
イーロハ。
……おっ？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: What's wrong? You're usually all sunshine and sparkles. Is it gonna snow tomorrow?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうした、
元気印のあんたがそんな暗い顔。
明日は雪かな？

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Aunt Sono...! Uu...uuu...!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ソノおばちゃん……っ！
うっ……
うっ
……！！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAAHNNNNNNNN!!
text_block_list.orig_text: うわああぁぁああ～～～んっ！！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Whoa. You've turned on the real waterworks. ...Come on, c'mere and I'll give you a good ol' head pat. Here, here...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うお。
めっちゃ泣くじゃん。
……ほら、
よしよししたげるから
こっち来な。
ほれ、
よしよし。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry, Sono-chan. Iroha's nose snot is all over your clothes...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っ。
ごめんね、
ソノちゃん。
お洋服にイロハのお鼻、
いっぱいついちゃったぁ……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Eh, whatever. I’ve been putting off washing this outfit anyway. Now's a good time to do laundry, thank you for the snot. ...So, what happened?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ああ、
この服めんどくて洗ってなかったから。
洗濯するいい機会だよ、
ナイス鼻水。
……で、
なにがあったの？

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Mm... You know, it's Grandpa... He's so mean...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん……
あのね。
おじいちゃんってば、
ひどいんだぁ……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm, hmm, you wanted to have a swordfight with Grandpa but he wouldn't take you seriously. Just because you're a kid.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふんふん、
おじいちゃんと剣術勝負したいのに、
あんたと真剣勝負で戦ってくれないと。
あんたが子どもだからって理由で。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Well... that checks out.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
そりゃそーだろ。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Sono-chan, are you also on Grandpa's side?! ...I see. He’s your dad, so of course you’d pick him over me...! A niece can’t beat a dad in the family rankings...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ！？　
ソノちゃんもおじいちゃん派！？
……
そっか、
おじいちゃんはソノちゃんのお父さんだもんね……！
３しんとーの姪より、
１しんとーのお父さんの方が大事なんだ……！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: What an annoying thing to say. That's got nothing to do with it. You seriously don't know how much I care about you... don't underestimate me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
めっちゃめんどいこと言うじゃん。
そんなん関係ないっての。
てか
うちがどんだけあんたのこと好きか……
なめんじゃないわよ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Dad... Your Grandpa, Iroha, is the founder of the Isurugi school of swordsmanship. They call him a Sword Saint or something, I think. He’s got more disciples than fleas on a stray cat.
text_block_list.orig_text:
父さん……
イロハのおじいちゃんは
イスルギ流剣術の開祖。
なんか知らんけど
剣聖とか言われてるらしいじゃん。
弟子も死ぬほどいるしさ。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Iroha's also a disciple.
text_block_list.orig_text: イロハも弟子だもん。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Yup. And you're the strongest, even if you're a kid. Your Grandpa's always bragging about you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん、
子どもなのに
一番強いんだよね。
おじいちゃん
いっつもあんたのこと自慢してるよ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Well. The point is, don't be so hasty. You're turning ten this year, right? You'll be an adult in no time, so just bear with it for now, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
そう焦んなって。
あんた今年10歳でしょ？
あっという間に大人になるから
我慢しな？

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: I can't wait. Iroha wants to fight Grandpa now... because... Anyway! The point's that Iroha wants to fight Grandpa NOW...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
待てないよ。
イロハ今すぐ戦いたい……
だって……
…
…とにかくっ。
イロハは今すぐおじいちゃんと戦うの……！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: If he says he won't fight me until I'm an adult, then... Iroha wants to be an adult right now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大人じゃなきゃ戦ってくれないってんならさ……
イロハは今すぐ大人になりたいっ！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Whoa, what a waste. You should definitely not wish for that, you know? Childhood is the greatest treasure in the world, are you aware? It's a kind of treasure that all adults wish for but can never have.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーわ、
もったいな。
そんなん絶対やめとけ？
子ども時代ってのはさ、
この世界で一番の宝物なんだよ？
大人みんなが欲しいと願っても
絶対に手に入らない宝物なんだからさ。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: ...Then, Sono-chan, you want to be a kid, too?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……じゃあソノちゃんも、
子どもになりたいの？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Hmm? Well... yeah, kinda.
text_block_list.orig_text:
んー？　
そりゃ、
まーね。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, hey?! Why are you pulling me along all of a sudden?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……って、
おい！？
急に引っ張ってどうしたの……！？

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Iroha just had a great idea! Hey, Sono-chan! Do you know the deer lady who lives in a house on the hill?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ……
イロハいいこと思いついちゃった！
ねえソノちゃん！
高台のお家に住んでる
鹿のおねーさんのこと知ってる！？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: The deer... Ah, you mean that alchemist girl? Maristella’s granddaughter... what was her name again?
text_block_list.orig_text:
鹿の……
ああ、
錬金術師の女の子でしょ。
マリステラさんのお孫さんの……
名前なんて言ったかな。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Louise Marie-chan! I bump into her at the bookstore sometimes! Though she always darts off behind that pink curtain at the store, so I've never had a chance to talk to her...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ルイズマリーちゃんだよっ！　
たまに本屋さんで会うの！
でもすぐに奥のピンクのカーテンの方に行っちゃうから、
ちゃんとお話ししたことはないんだけど！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...That girl, isn't she 16...? Well, whatever. So, what do you want from this Louise Marie-chan?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あの子16歳じゃなかった……？　
まあいいわ。
で、
そのルイズマリーちゃんが何なのよ。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: He-he-he! We’ll ask her to make it for us... with alchemy! An elixir that'll make both of our dreams come true!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふっふっふ！
錬金術で作ってもらおうよ！
イロハとソノちゃんの夢を叶える薬！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Huh...? You're telling me something that'll make you an adult, Iroha, and me a kid? No, no, I was joking about wanting to return to be a kid.
text_block_list.orig_text:
は……？
まさか、
イロハは大人に。
私は
子どもになれる的な？
いやいや
私の子どもになりたいは冗談だし。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: In the first place, even an alchemist wouldn't be able to make such a dreamlike elixir.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そもそも、
いくら錬金術師とはいえ、
そんな夢みたいな薬なんて
作れるわけないでしょうが。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: It'll be okay! After all, Louise Marie is a genius!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫だよ！
だってルイズマリーちゃんって、
天才なんだもんっ！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Eh...? A genius?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え……
天才？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. Heheh, perfect♪ Behold! The "Memory-Reawakening Forbidden Elixir"... is a total success!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふう。
ふふ、
完璧♪
『記憶を呼び起こす秘薬』
大成功よ！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: A replay of the memories concerning our meeting, huh. Now that I think about it, you were already smug and full of yourself back then, Rui-chan.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私たちの出会いの記憶の再現か。
そういや出会った時から
ルイちゃんどやってたな。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: I-I was not smug or full of myself!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ど、
どやってなんかないですけどっ！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. And then, after that, Rui-chan made it for us! The "Forbidden Body-switching Elixir"!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへっ。
それであの後、
ルイちゃん作ってくれたんだよね！
『入れ替わりの秘薬』っ！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Well, it was supposed to wear off in a few minutes, so me and Iroha drank it on a whim. ...Never imagined we'd get stuck like this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
数十分で元に戻れるってことだったから、
ノリでイロハと飲んでみたら。
……まさか戻れなくなっちゃうなんてね。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...I-I'm sorry. I was, and am, too much of a genius so I ended up over-succeeding. So much that... even a year later you're still like this...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ご、
ごめんなさい。
天才過ぎて
成功しすぎちゃった。
成功しすぎて、
入れ替わったまま一年も戻れてないなんて……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Hehe, that's what we call a failure.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
それ失敗だから。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Iroha's happier this way! It's like I'm always with my beloved Sono-chan♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
イロハはこっちの方がうれしいよ！
大好きなソノちゃんと
いつも一緒にいられるみたいだもん♪

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...What's with that? Such a sudden cute sneak attack...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なんだよ。
不意打ちでかわいいこと言ってくるじゃん。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. So, you two. I've finally finished it, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふふっ。
ということでお二人さん。
ついに完成したわよ？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: A Forbidden Elixir that'll return you back where you belong. The "Forbidden Elixir: No. 567"!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
二人を元に戻す秘薬。
『禁断の秘薬：
No.567』がね！！

text_block_list.name: Sono Iroha
text_block_list.text: Huh?!
text_block_list.orig_text: えっ！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: With this, the two of you should be able to return to normal...! Then, let's get this going!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これで二人は元通りの姿に戻れるはず……！
じゃあ早速いくわよ～！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: "Forbidden Elixir"... RELEASEEEEE!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
『禁断の秘薬』
噴射～っ！！

text_block_list.name: Sono Iroha
text_block_list.orig_text: うう……っ。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Come on, succeed...! Please!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さあ、
成功して……！
お願いっ！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Babuuu.
text_block_list.orig_text: ばぶー

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: H-Huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
は……
はい？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Babubabuuu.
text_block_list.orig_text: ばぶばぶー

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: WHAAAAAA-?!
text_block_list.orig_text: なんて～っ！？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: HAH! Don't tell me... instead of returning to how they were, they returned to their baby days...!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はっ、
もしかして……
姿が元に戻るんじゃなくて、
赤ちゃん時代に戻ってる……？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...Ah... ahaha. Well! Guess I’m just too much of a genius, I’ve discovered a brand-new effect!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あ、
あはは。
よし。
天才過ぎて、
新たな効果を発見よ！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: You just messed up. Ah, I'm back.
text_block_list.orig_text:
失敗な。
あ、
戻った。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...Sorry, I promise I’ll get it right next time! I've already got a new formula in mind!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ごめんね、
今度こそ成功するように頑張るから。
次の薬の構想はもう出来上がってるの！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Okay, I'll go buy the ingredients!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃ、
素材買ってきまーす！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Rui-chan, are you going to be okay on your own? You still don't know the area... Ah, she's gone. That girl's really a bundle of positivity. Hehe.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ルイちゃん一人で大丈夫？
まだ土地勘ない……
ああ、
行っちゃった。
ほんとポジティブだわ
あの子。
ふふ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: More importantly, we've got to worry about our daily life. Our financial situation is so tight...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それより。
もっと大事なのは日々の生活。
ひっ迫する台所事情がやばすぎる……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Really, what's going on...? It's been three months since we opened the Alces Atelier shop, and we still haven't had a single customer...!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
ってかどういうことよ……？
アルケス錬金堂をオープンしてから３か月たつのに。
まだお客さんが一人も来ないなんてさぁ……！？

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I wonder why? I mean, it’s a shop where Rui-chan can make anything with alchemy. That should be amazing, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
う～ん、
なんでかな？
ルイちゃんが錬金術で何でも作っちゃうお店。
ちょーすごいのにね？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Yeah... "A shop that has everything, even things that might not exist". I thought the concept was solid, but... I guess the fact this place used to be a monster den is still scaring people off.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん……
無いものは無いお店。
何でもあるお店。
結構いけると思うんだけど……
ちょっと前まで
魔物の巣
ってイメージが悪すぎる。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...At this rate, we'll be in serious trouble. Maybe I should talk to Karin. ...Actually, I've got some kind of idea.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……このままじゃマジでやばいね。
カリンさんに相談してみるか。
……実は
一個アイデア考えてるんだ。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: An idea? What is it, what is it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
アイデア？
なになに？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Having a celebrity be our store's manager for a day... How does that sound?
text_block_list.orig_text:
有名人に
一日店長で来てもらう……
なんてどうかな？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: All right... I've bought some pretty nifty materials. I'll use them to conjure the perfect forbidden elixir that will return those two to normal! For sure this time!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よし……
めぼしい素材は買えたわね。
これを使って
必ず元に戻る秘薬、
完成してみせるわ！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Uh... Huh? Where am I? The map says... okay, this is north, right? No wait, maybe I'm facing south... which means if I follow this road...
text_block_list.orig_text:
っと……
あれ、
ここはどこ？
地図は……
えと、
こっちが北……
よね？
え、
南かも……
ということは
この先の道を……

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...N-No way, this can't be. I'm not Iroha-chan. I can't be lost... There's no way I'd get lost...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
そ
、
そんなまさか。
イロハちゃんじゃないんだから私。
道に迷ってなんて……
迷子になっただなんてありえな……

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: HOW ARE YOU EVEN SUPPOSED TO READ A MAPPPPP?!
text_block_list.orig_text: 地図ってどう読むわけ～～～っ！？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: A-Anyway, I-I'm sure that if I just turn that corner, I'll find a path I recognize...! Hah... hah, hah... Now~...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
と、
とにかく
あそこの角を曲がれば
きっと知ってる道に出る筈……！
は……っ、
は……っ。
ほら──

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Kyaa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
き
ゃあっ！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...O-Owwww... Hey, where do you think you're looking while walking?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……い、
いたた～……っ。
ちょ、
あなたどこ見て歩いてんのよぉっ！？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...Honestly! I'm not gonna just forgive you because...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……まったく！
許さないんだか──

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: N-No, I'm fine.
text_block_list.orig_text:
い、
いえ。
大丈夫です。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ....destined.

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...My Destined Prince♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
……運命の
王子さま♪

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: A few days later, the girls from Alces would ask the the top idol, Nozomi from Carmina, to be their store manager for a day.
text_block_list.orig_text:
この数日後、
【アルケス錬金堂】は、
トップアイドル・カルミナのノゾミに一日店長を依頼する。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Louise Marie is also reunited with her Destined Prince, who had appeared with Nozomi... but that's a story for another day.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ルイズマリーは、
ノゾミと共に現れた運命の王子様と再会を果たすのだが──
それはまた、
別のお話。
